$comment: The playground's caps, enforced by runner.py and printed on the page. browserFactor converts mf.estimate()'s one-core native seconds into browser seconds: measured in Pyodide at 7x (one instrument) to 25x (whole markets) the estimate, so 25 keeps the cap honest. maxSeconds is the longest a request may take in the browser, by that conversion. calibrationSeconds is the one-off cost of the first request for each market in a visit: MarketForge calibrates the market's regimes with a multi-million-step chain (0.15 s compiled, measured at these values in Pyodide).
